description: 公共下水道の状況 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 狛江市. 【狛江市】令和４年度「統計こまえ」に掲載された公共下水道の状況です。 （注意事項） ・総人口は、各年度末の日本人と外国人を合わせた数である。 ・普及率面積は、多摩川河川敷を除く582haで算出。. Coverage: 狛江市. The portal files it under the publisher 狛江市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
